name: isotox-full11
comment: EVERY ISOTOXAL OUTLINE THE D=120 GRID CARRIES, IN ONE PALETTE (AL, 2026-08-31). The 11 outlines are the boundaries of {5/2}, {6/2}, {8/2}, {8/3}, {10/2}, {10/3}, {10/4}, {12/2}, {12/3}, {12/4} and {12/5}: point angle 60*(n-2d)/n units, which is an integer exactly for these. 7-pointed and 9-pointed stars need a grid divisible by 7 or 9 and are off this one entirely. Together with the seven regular n-gons whose corner is a whole number of units (3,4,5,6,8,10,12) that is 29 corner classes. Under mixed closure enum_configs applies no angle bound, so the alphabet is ~C^V/(2V): ~25.0M configurations, 124x isotox-mixed, of which 96% are valence 6. This palette is the COMPLETE single run; the 55 pair palettes are its decomposition by star family and cover only solids using at most two of the eleven.
